comparisons.peer_summary: Cash flows from financing activities in fiscal year 2024 increased by $13,890 million compared to fiscal year 2023, primarily due to $39,954 million in net proceeds from the 2023 Term Loans and senior notes issuance. This increase was offset by larger payments on debt obligations ($19,205 million), employee withholding tax payments ($3,355 million), dividend payments ($2,169 million), and stock repurchases ($1,352 million).

AVGO's 2024 financing activities included $1,352 million in stock repurchases and $2,169 million in dividends, while MU's 2022 activities included $2.43 billion in repurchases and $461 million in dividends. AVGO also highlights significant proceeds from long-term borrowings ($39,954 million) and corresponding debt payments ($19,205 million), whereas MU reported $2.00 billion in proceeds from new notes/bonds offset by $2.03 billion in debt redemptions.
